Foundation Industries is hiring a Software Engineer to build and operate its software-defined manufacturing platform. The role focuses on backend workflow engines, data models, APIs, and integrations, and includes owning features through deployment and applying AI to engineering and operational workflows.
Hardware
Industrial
Manufacturing
Industrial Automation
Industrial Engineering
No H1B
Responsibilities
We’re hiring a Software Engineer to work with the Head of Software to build and operate this platform
The work centers on the deep backend ERP/MES-like workflow engines, data models, and integrations that run the factory
You’ll own features and technical areas from design through deployment and ongoing operation, working directly with manufacturing, operations, and commercial teams to turn operational needs into reliable production systems
The Head of Software will own the roadmap, architectural direction, and engineering standards; you’ll contribute to technical design and take ownership of execution
You’ll also help apply AI to accelerate engineering and automate operational workflows, with careful attention to correctness, security, and measurable value
Execute against the software roadmap and own projects through production
Develop deep context on the platform and factory
Stabilize and harden the core backend through testing, monitoring, and debugging
Build reliable workflows, data models, APIs, and integrations that support increasing operational complexity
Apply AI where it creates measurable value
Help build the manufacturing operating system
Grow ownership of core systems and contribute to architectural decisions
Make AI a compounding advantage
Strengthen reliability, security, and compliance as the platform scales

Experience testing, deploying, monitoring, and debugging production software
High ownership, practical judgment, and clear communication with technical and operational partners
